articles.title_en: Pro-War Blogger Vanishes From Public After Telegram Post About Oleshky Evacuation
articles.lead_en: Vladimir Romanov posted and then later deleted a message on his channel that said only four buses filled with residents from Oleshky had departed for Russia during the ceasefire, as opposed to 17 buses that carried evacuees to Ukrainian territory.

articles.title_en: Teacher from Ukraine’s Kharkiv dies in Russian custody in occupied Crimea. She was arrested while visiting her parents.
articles.lead_en: Oleksandra Kazarovytska (Kolesnikova), one of the founders of the Kharkiv-based language school “Professional,” has died in Russian-occupied Crimea, the school said on Facebook. The school said Russia “killed” Kazarovitskaya.

articles.title_en: Ukraine releases bodycam footage from Komyshuvakha, where at least 42 people were killed in a Russian strike. The officer who filmed it was among the dead.
articles.lead_en: Ukraine’s National Police released bodycam footage from one of the officers who took part in evacuating residents of Komyshuvakha, in the Zaporizhzhia region, where a Russian strike killed more than 40 people.

articles.title_en: Occupied Crimea extends school break as Ukrainian strikes leave the peninsula without power
articles.lead_en: Crimea has extended its school break amid power outages, Sergei Aksyonov, the Russia-appointed head of the annexed region, confirmed on Wednesday.
